An absent offer or link therefore yields OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than an uncaught or compliant Boolean result. Deliberately restricted assessment domains remain a possible interpretation, but require reconciliation with the typed questions.

node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5 and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 combine offer-level promotion with an existential non-discount gift component without expressly requiring that same component to bear the promotional link. Mixed-purpose offers could be overincluded unless supplied classifications enforce this connection.

node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f limits the promoted specific product to an SFC-authorised fund. The circular's context supports that narrower scope, while its quotation of paragraph 3.11 refers to investment products generally. Neither interpretation should silently replace the other.

For node.142f34016b300f5c110eb249, provider must identify the distributor making the offer rather than merely a funder or fulfiller. node.bc55be7e973a689d07f9e64b explicitly requires offer attribution; the source does not exhaustively resolve third-party attribution.

Paragraph 9 says guaranteed returns or incentives may be gifts. It neither automatically classifies every incentive as a gift nor exempts structured products from the gift restriction. The candidates leave substantive classification to supplied judgments.
